observer_accuracy: JPL Horizons -96 SSB vectors at 10 min sampling (yearly chunks); at the 0.046 AU perihelion the chord sagitta over one step is ~2e-6 AU = 0.0003 R_sun, negligible. Heliocentric 0.046-0.73 AU orbit (period 88-150 d, Venus-flyby shrinking): the Earth-center list is meaningless for PSP at every rung; the observer crosses each Sun-star axis twice per orbit at whatever heliocentric radius the orbit has at the star's (anti-)longitude
